notes.title: Update 11.04.2018
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have a very small update this week.
As promised I added the entry font size slider to the codex and a previous choices hide/show option to the settings menu. 

This week, I finally finished Chapter 10.
It was really intense, I am so excited about this chapter especially!
Can't wait to see it in the game.

If everything goes right, I'll be revising chapter 10 for the rest of this week, and will start adding Chapter 9 to the game.

(And if I get a little free time, I can start working on Chapter 11 in the script.)

As always, I'll be waiting for your feedback. =)

See you next week!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32263382/15328a037e6b14dcdddf7f17db573228d39b7b6a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 28.03.2018
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This is the first update of Cardinal Cross since the Early Access release.

I want to give you weekly updates about the progress of the game, if it won't be too overwhelming to you. 
The last thing I want is to spam your community hub feed.

This week was all about listening to your suggestions, and fixing the bugs/errors in the game.

Here is what the small update (or should I say patch?) contains;

[list]
    [*] Fixed a bunch of spelling errors. English is not my native language, so yikes. There were quite a lot, huh?
    [*] Added Quick Save and Quick Load shortcut keys to the game. F4 for QS, F5 for QL.
    [*] Added a shortcut key for text history ("H"), and now it resets the scroll bar whenever you open it up.
    [*] Escape menu now has a gallery option, and saving the game through escape menu shows the proper scene picture now. (not a screenshot of the actual escape menu.)
    [*]  Enter key works for choice selecting now.
    [*]  Added a Previous button to the gallery.
    [*]  Updated the tutorial.
    [*]  Made the quick menu buttons larger.
    [*]  increased the font size slider.
    [*]  Added a missing CG to the gallery.
[/list]

I'll see you next week with hopefully teasers about the upcoming chapters.

Have a nice week! (half a week?)

-Rin
